note: Deed-gated unlocks. The Register shows the next one not yet earned.

bow_class.name: The Bow
bow_class.text: Hold the Kings' Ford once: the guard's composite bows come to the levy.

knife_class.name: The Knife
knife_class.text: Kill a deserter officer: the debt-slaves' nets and knives are yours.

hold_ford_ambition.name: Hold the ford road
hold_ford_ambition.text: Carry the archive out once: a shorter, harder writ.

wandering_smith.name: The smith on the road
wandering_smith.text: Honour two moulds: the guild sends journeymen down the roads.

reed_recruits.name: Recruits from the reed country
reed_recruits.text: Survive the Drowned Mile twice: foreign spears come up the coast.

ships_ambition.name: Get one named hero to the ships
ships_ambition.text: Survive two sieges: the harbourmasters will take a named passenger.

drown_ambition.name: Drown the Temple
drown_ambition.text: Burn the ink once: the writ finds a use for someone who hates the Temple.

found_ambition.name: Found a city in the ruins
found_ambition.text: Hold six roads: the Palace lists a ruin as yours to raise.
